# Construction Calculators

> > Comprehensive online construction calculators for cost estimation, material quantities, and project planning across residential and commercial building projects.

Construction Calculators provides specialized tools for contractors, builders, and homeowners to accurately estimate costs, calculate material requirements, and plan construction projects. The platform covers concrete work, HVAC systems, foundations, roofing, insulation, and project management metrics including Earned Value Management (EVM) for schedule tracking.

## Key Topics

- Cost Estimation
- Construction Budgeting
- Concrete Calculations
- Earned Value Management (EVM)
- Energy Efficiency (SEER ratings)
- CMU (Concrete Masonry Units)
- Foundation Planning
- HVAC System Sizing
- Insulation R-values
- Material Quantities
- Project Management
- Schedule Variance Tracking
- Building Permits
- Commercial Construction
- Residential Construction

## Cost Estimation & Budgeting

- [Building Estimate Calculator](https://constructioncalculators.net/cost/building-estimate-calculator): Estimates total building costs for residential/commercial construction
- [Concrete Estimator Calculator](https://constructioncalculators.net/cost/concrete-estimator-calculator): Calculates concrete yardage, weight, and cost for slabs and footings
- [Foundation Cost Calculator](https://constructioncalculators.net/cost/foundation-cost-calculator): Estimates foundation costs by area, type, depth, and material selection
- [Insulation Cost Calculator](https://constructioncalculators.net/cost/insulation-cost-calculator): Estimates insulation costs by type, R-value, and area for walls/attics
- [New HVAC System Cost Calculator](https://constructioncalculators.net/cost/new-hvac-system-cost-calculator): Estimates HVAC installation costs by home size, SEER rating, and ductwork
- [Roof Repair Cost Calculator](https://constructioncalculators.net/cost/roof-repair-cost-calculator): Estimates roof repair costs by damage type, size, pitch, and materials
- [Building Permit Cost Calculator](https://constructioncalculators.net/cost/building-permit-cost-calculator): Estimates building permit fees by project size, location, and type
- [Warehouse Construction Cost Calculator](https://constructioncalculators.net/cost/warehouse-construction-cost-calculator): Estimates PEMB warehouse costs including slab, utilities, and HVAC
- [Commercial Painting Cost Calculator](https://constructioncalculators.net/cost/commercial-painting-cost-calculator): Estimates commercial painting costs by area, paint type, and labor rates

## Concrete & Masonry

- [Concrete Estimator Calculator](https://constructioncalculators.net/cost/concrete-estimator-calculator): Calculates concrete yardage, weight, and cost for slabs and footings
- [Masonry Block Calculator](https://constructioncalculators.net/concerete/masonry-block-calculator): Calculates CMU block quantities needed for masonry wall construction
- [Crushed Stone Calculator](https://constructioncalculators.net/concerete/crushed-stone-calculator): Calculates crushed stone volume in cubic yards or tons for projects

## Project Management & Planning

- [Schedule Variance Calculator](https://constructioncalculators.net/general/schedule-variance-calculator): EVM schedule variance calculator for tracking project timeline performance
- [Floor Area Ratio Calculator](https://constructioncalculators.net/general/floor-area-ratio-calculator): Computes FAR for zoning compliance and buildable floor area planning
- [Angle Cut Calculator](https://constructioncalculators.net/general/angle-cut-calculator): Calculates precise cut angles for wood framing, roofing, and miter cuts
- [Rolling Offset Calculator](https://constructioncalculators.net/general/rolling-offset-calculator): Calculates pipe travel and true offset for plumbing and HVAC piping

## Interior & Finishing

- [Crown Molding Installation Cost Calculator](https://constructioncalculators.net/cost/crown-molding-installation-cost-calculator): Estimates crown molding costs by room size, material (MDF/PVC), and finish
- [Double Pane Window Cost Calculator](https://constructioncalculators.net/cost/double-pane-window-cost-calculator): Estimates ENERGY STAR window costs with Low-E glass and gas fill options
- [Dormer Cost Calculator](https://constructioncalculators.net/cost/dormer-cost-calculator): Calculates dormer addition costs by dimensions, roof type, and style

## Specialized Services

- [Mold Remediation Cost Calculator](https://constructioncalculators.net/cost/mold-remediation-cost-calculator): Estimates mold removal costs by area, type, damage level, and labor
- [Moving Cost Calculator](https://constructioncalculators.net/cost/moving-cost-calculator-2): Estimates moving costs by distance, size, and service requirements
